race.comment: CALM THE PRESS (1) improved nicely second up but found one better over 1100m at Naracoorte. Peaking now and can finally break through. IMMORTALLY LUCKY (7) improved last time out, finishing second at the end of 1050m at Balaklava after being in the firing line on the corner. Well placed and there is no reason she cannot find winning ways. HELLFIRE JESS (6) returns for the Dabernig camp and strips fitter for two jumpouts. Drawn well and is one of the main chances. THE MUSCLE (5) made an encouraging debut last time out, finishing fourth over 1050m at Balaklava. Is sure to have come on from that and can give this a shake.
